facts.value: Students must achieve specified credits (CP) by the end of a designated semester. For part-time students, the deadline is extended, counting semesters in part-time study as half semesters. Students who do not meet the required credits by the end of the set deadline will be asked by the examination office to seek academic advising. Failure to reach the required credit count within the final deadline, without conditions for an extension, will result in loss of examination eligibility in the Bachelor minor.
